[center][size=5][b][color=#38761d]Some children are ornaments.[/color] [color=#a64d79]These ones grow. [/color][/b][/size][/center]

Growing Children Expanded (GCE) is the childhood DLC I always dreamed of: every farmer's child becomes a real person — with a personality, a career, friends at home, illnesses and birthdays, midnight mining trips and letters from a home they left — while everything still feels like vanilla Stardew.

[size=4][b][color=#7030A0]▸ Why I Built This[/color][/b][/size]

My wife and I have played Stardew Valley together on split screen in our living room for over a year. A few months ago I picked up an already-excellent mod — Growing Children by Gustavo Henrique — which makes the farmers' kids actually grow up. Almost at the same time, my wife became pregnant with our first child — and with that on my mind, I kept the children's stories going. Through the months of developing, I kept imagining: what will our child love doing? What kind of person will they be? What will they say?

For example, early in development there was a "bug": after a child finished watching TV, the TV stayed on. It reminded me of my own childhood — my parents worked late, and I would switch the TV on without really watching it, just so the house had a sound that said someone was home. So I kept it. To this day, if a child in the game finishes watching TV and no parent is home, the television is left glowing. And it reminds me to try never to leave our own child home alone.

Those imaginings grew into Growing Children Expanded. The children in the game will be born first; when the real one arrives, they will grow up together on the same farm. And I hope these children grow up alongside your family, too.

[color=#9900ff][size=4][b]▸ Compatibility （in a Special way）[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#9900ff][size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50597/50597-1789371133-834106462.png[/img]   [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50597/50597-1789371200-1890796404.png[/img]（GrowingValley Kitso， with/without a hat）[/b][/size][/color]

GCE can read child appearance and dialogue assets from other Mods — most notably [b]Growing Valley[/b] — so your children can use those looks and lines inside GCE's own system.

[quote][color=#C00000][b]Important: do NOT install these packs as standalone mods.[/b][/color] Their own logic would conflict with GCE (GCE retires/disables them at runtime). Instead, [b]place the pack's folder inside GCE's own folder[/b], under:

[code]GrowingChildrenExpanded/
└── Supported Other Mods/
    └── <Growing Valley - Child NPCs>[/code][/quote]
GCE scans that folder at startup and reads the packs [b]read-only[/b]: only their sprite, portrait, material and dialogue text assets. GCE never writes into their files, never executes their mod logic, never redistributes them, and if a pack is missing or removed, children automatically fall back to GCE's own built-in appearance — no errors, no broken saves.

[b][color=#1F7A5C]Supported pack assets:[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Growing Valley - Child NPCs [/b] — child appearances: regular and special child sprites/portraits, hair/eye/clothing material options, and seasonal/weather-gated borrowed dialogue lines (read from the pack's own language file when it has one).[/*]
[*][b]The Farmer's Children[/b] — borrowed daily dialogue lines only (same seasonal/weather rules); its sprites are not used.[/*]
[*][b]LittleNPCs[/b] — no new assets are taken; GCE only cleans up leftover entities and texture references from saves created while LittleNPCs was active.[/*]
[/list]
In the dress-up menu, every child can independently choose an appearance source: [b]Auto[/b] (default), GCE's [b]Adult Native Look[/b], [b]Growing Valley regular child[/b] look, [b]Growing Valley special child[/b] look, or [b]Native Child[/b] look (GCE's own toddler sprites). Without these packs everything still works — children just use GCE's built-in looks.

[size=4][b][color=#7030A0]▸ Changelog Summary [/color][/b][/size]

[code]

2.9.49 — Work-Route Recovery and Logging Control
Fixed
Children stuck at travel hubs. A child that could not reach its destination through a hub (for example the SVE Enchanted Grove route toward the Adventurer Summit) used to stand there retrying forever. It now walks back to the tile it came from, and that dead hop is remembered for the rest of the session so the same route is not attempted again. A forced hop is only used when there is nothing left to walk back to.
Getting to work and back home. The two-step chain is restored: the child walks to the mine entrance location and enters from there, and the same entrance tile anchors the walk home afterwards.
Bedtime. Children no longer stand next to the bed bubbling without getting in. The walk refusal is now classified and its pacing is time-boxed, so the sleep transaction completes (confirmed in a real session: all three children reached their beds).
Hat placement while walking. The walking-offset experiments that made hats sit too low were rolled back, and hat placement is owned by the baked sheet again (confirmed visually: "both hats are correct now").

Changed
Quiet logs by default. With default settings the mod now writes only errors and severe problems. Performance and GC watchdog warnings moved from always-on to the warning switch, and routine contract records moved to the debug switch — no non-error line can be forced into your log any more. Enable "warning logging" for performance warnings, or "debug logging" for detailed traces.
Companion tool shipped in the same download. The release archive now includes the GCE Save Tool (
GrowingChildrenExpandedSaveTool/
), a separate optional mod for offline save surgery.

[size=5][b][color=#1F7A5C]中文[/color][/b][/size]

[center][size=5][b][color=#1F7A5C]有些孩子只是摆设，[/color] [color=#C00000]你的孩子会长大。[/color][/b][/size][/center]

Growing Children Expanded（GCE）就是我梦想中的星露谷童年 DLC：让每一位农场主的孩子变成真实的人——有性格、有事业、有家里的牵挂、有疾病和生日、有深夜的下矿冒险，也有离开家之后寄回来的信——而一切仍然像原版一样自然。

[size=4][b][color=#C55A11]▸ 我为什么做这个模组[/color][/b][/size]

我和妻子在自家客厅的分屏上，一起玩了《星露谷物语》一年有余。几个月前，我装上了一款本就出色的模组——Gustavo Henrique 的 Growing Children（成长中的孩子），它能让农场里的孩子真正长大。几乎就在同一时间，妻子怀上了我们的第一个孩子。心里揣着这件事，我便接着把孩子们的故事写了下去。在开发的这几个月里，我一直在想：我们的孩子会喜欢做什么？会成为什么样的人？又会说些什么呢？

比如，开发早期有个“bug”：孩子看完电视，电视不会自动关掉。我想起自己小时候——父母下班晚，我也会打开电视，并不看，只是想让屋子里有一点“有人在”的声音。我把它当特性留了下来：直到今天，游戏里的孩子看完电视，只要家里一个大人都没有，电视就还亮着。它也在提醒我：以后尽量，别让自己的孩子一个人待在家里。

这些幻想后来长成了一个模组——Growing Children Expanded。游戏里的孩子会先出生；等真正的 TA 来到这个世界，TA 会和这些孩子一起，在同一座农场上长大。也希望这些孩子，能陪你和你的家人一起长大。

[size=4][b][color=#C55A11]▸ 特殊兼容性——外部外观与对话素材包[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][b][color=#C55A11][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50597/50597-1789371133-834106462.png[/img]   [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50597/50597-1789371200-1890796404.png[/img] （GrowingValley Kitso，GCE自绘帽子/无帽子） [/color][/b][/size]

GCE 可以读取其他内容包里的孩子外观与对话素材——最主要的是 [b]Growing Valley[/b]——让你的孩子能在 GCE 自己的体系里用上那些外观和台词。

[quote][color=#C00000][b]重要：不要把这类素材包当作独立 Mod 安装。[/b][/color]它们自带的逻辑会和 GCE 冲突（GCE 会在运行时退役/禁用它们）。正确做法是[b]把素材包的文件夹放进 GCE 自己的文件夹里[/b]：

[code]GrowingChildrenExpanded/
└── Supported Other Mods/
    └── <Growing Valley - Child NPCs>[/code][/quote]
GCE 启动时扫描该目录，并[b]只读[/b]素材包：只读取精灵图、肖像、材质与对话文本素材。GCE 永不写入它们的文件、永不执行它们的模组逻辑 、 更不会直接内置这些模组；素材缺失或被移除时，孩子会自动回退到 GCE 自带外观——不报错、不损坏存档。

[b][color=#2E75B6]支持的素材包：[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Growing Valley - Child NPCs [/b]——孩子外观：普通与特殊孩子精灵图/肖像、发型/瞳色/服装材质选项，以及按季节/天气筛选的借用对话（该包有对应语言文件时直接读它的原文）。[/*]
[*][b]The Farmer's Children[/b]——仅借用日常对话台词（同样的季节/天气规则），不取用它的精灵图。[/*]
[*][b]LittleNPCs[/b]——不取用任何新素材；GCE 只清理旧存档中 LittleNPCs 留下的实体与纹理引用。[/*]
[/list]
在装扮菜单里，每个孩子可以独立选择外观来源：[b]自动[/b]（默认）、GCE 的[b]成人原生形象[/b]、[b]Growing Valley 普通孩子素材[/b]、[b]Growing Valley 特殊孩子素材[/b]、或[b]小孩原生形象[/b]（GCE 自带幼儿贴图）。没有这些素材包一切也照常工作——孩子只是使用 GCE 自带外观。


[line]

[size=4][b][color=#C55A11]▸ 配套生态[/color][/b][/size]

三个配套模组都是独立模组：没有 GCE 也能运行，装在一起时联动更深。

[list]
[*][b]Vanilla Tips[/b]（[color=#C55A11]neoiw.vanillatips[/color]）——换日黑屏的原生机制小提示，多语言，支持自定义提示与 GMCM 控制。安装 GCE 后自动接管 GCE 自己的睡前提示。[/*]
[*][b]Leisure Time[/b]（[color=#C55A11]neoiw.LeisureTime[/color]）——独立时间控制（可调时钟流速、休闲模式）。安装 GCE 后完全退休：不重复处理事件、补丁或消息，时间流由 GCE 接管。[/*]
[*][b]GCE Save Tool[/b]（[color=#C55A11]neoiw.GrowingChildrenExpandedSaveTool[/color]）——独立标题界面存档工具：每次写入前完整备份，白名单修改孩子数据且可预览，修复旧载荷、异常值、孤儿记录与旧卸载备份，一键撤销受安全门禁保护，带操作日志，发现其他游戏进程占用存档时拒绝写入。[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b][color=#C55A11]▸ 更新说明[/color][/b][/size]

[code] 2.9.49 — 出行恢复与日志开关
已修复
孩子卡在传送枢纽不动。以前孩子在枢纽（例如 SVE 魔法森林通往冒险者山顶那条路）走不通时会原地一直重试。现在它会退回自己来的那一格，并且这一跳在本次游戏内会被记住，同样的死路不会再走一遍。只有在"连退回的地方都没有"时才会用一次强制跳转。
上班与回家。恢复了"先走到矿井入口所在地、再从这里进矿"的两段式链路，回家行程也锚在同一格入口上。
睡觉上床。孩子不再站在床边冒泡却上不了床：拒绝会被分类，节奏也有时间上限，就寝事务能正常完成（实机确认：三个孩子全部上床）。
走路时帽子的位置。把导致帽子偏低的那几次走路位移试验回滚，帽子位置重新由图集烘焙唯一供给（实机目视确认："2 个帽子都正常了"）。

已变更
默认日志变安静。默认设置下模组只输出错误和严重问题。性能与 GC 看门狗告警从"永远输出"改到警告开关下，例行契约记录改到调试开关下——除错误以外，不再有任何一行日志是关不掉的。想看性能告警就打开"启用警告日志"，想看详细追踪就打开"启用调试日志"。
配套工具随包发布。发布包现在包含 GCE 存档工具（
GrowingChildrenExpandedSaveTool/
），它是独立的可选模组，用于离线存档手术。
